question: 设二元函数 $f(u, v)$ 具有连续的偏导数，且对任意实数 $t$ 满足 $f(tu, tv) = t^2 f(u, v)$ ， $f(1, 2) = 0$ 和 $f_u(1, 2) = 3$ ，求极限 $\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1}{x} \int_0^x \left[ 1 + f\left( t - \sin t + 1, \sqrt{1 + t^3} + 1 \right) \right]^{\frac{1}{\ln(1 + t^3)}} \mathrm{d}t.$
answer: 连续，则有 $\lim_{x\to 0}f\left(x - \sin x + 1,\sqrt{1 + x^3} +1\right) = f(1,2) = 0$ ，利用等价无穷小替换，有

steps.text: 分析 该极限属于 $\frac{0}{0}$ 型，可用洛必达法则与等价无穷小代替等方法计算。求导时要注意利用多元函数的全导数公式。也可用泰勒公式将 $f$ 展开后再求极限。

方法1 该极限属于 $\frac{0}{0}$ 型，由洛必达法则，得

$$
\begin{array}{r l} \text {原式} & = \lim _ {x \to 0} \left[ 1 + f \left(x - \sin x + 1, \sqrt {1 + x ^ {3}} + 1\right) \right] ^ {\frac {1}{\ln (1 + x ^ {3})}} \\ & = \exp \left[ \lim _ {x \to 0} \frac {\ln \left[ 1 + f \left(x - \sin x + 1 , \sqrt {1 + x ^ {3}} + 1\right) \right]}{\ln (1 + x ^ {3})} \right]. \end{array}\tag{①}
$$

由于 $f$ 连续，则有 $\lim_{x\to 0}f\left(x - \sin x + 1,\sqrt{1 + x^3} +1\right) = f(1,2) = 0$ ，利用等价无穷小替换，有

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {\underset {x \to 0} {\lim} \frac {\ln \left[ 1 + f \left(x - \sin x + 1 , \sqrt {1 + x ^ {3}} + 1\right) \right]}{\ln (1 + x ^ {3})} = \underset {x \to 0} {\lim} \frac {f \left(x - \sin x + 1 , \sqrt {1 + x ^ {3}} + 1\right)}{x ^ {3}}} \\ & {= \frac {1}{3} \underset {x \to 0} {\lim} \frac {\frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x} f \left(x - \sin x + 1 , \sqrt {1 + x ^ {3}} + 1\right)}{x ^ {2}} (\text {洛必达法则})} \\ & {= \frac {1}{3} \underset {x \to 0} {\lim} \frac {f _ {u} \left(x - \sin x + 1 , \sqrt {1 + x ^ {3}} + 1\right) (1 - \cos x) + f _ {v} \left(x - \sin x + 1 , \sqrt {1 + x ^ {3}} + 1\right) \frac {3 x ^ {2}}{2 \sqrt {1 + x ^ {3}}}}{x ^ {2}}} \\ & {= \frac {1}{3} \Bigg [ \underset {x \to 0} {\lim} f _ {u} \left(x - \sin x + 1, \sqrt {1 + x ^ {3}} + 1\right) \frac {1 - \cos x}{x ^ {2}} + \underset {x \to 0} {\lim} f _ {v} \left(x - \sin x + 1, \sqrt {1 + x ^ {3}} + 1\right) \frac {3}{2 \sqrt {1 + x ^ {3}}} \Bigg ]} \\ & {= \frac {1}{3} \Bigg [ f _ {u} (1, 2) \times \frac {1}{2} + f _ {v} (1, 2) \times \frac {3}{2} \Bigg ].} \end{array}\tag{②}
$$

为计算 $f_{\nu}(1,2)$ ，在等式 $f(tu,t\nu) = t^2 f(u,\nu)$ 的两边对 $t$ 求导，得

$$
f _ {1} (t u, t v) u + f _ {2} (t u, t v) v = 2 t f (u, v),
$$

令 $t = 1, u = 1, v = 2$ ，得

$$
f _ {1} (1, 2) \cdot 1 + f _ {2} (1, 2) \cdot 2 = 2 f (1, 2),
$$

即

$$
f _ {v} (1, 2) = f _ {2} (1, 2) = f (1, 2) - \frac {1}{2} f _ {1} (1, 2) = 0 - \frac {1}{2} \times 3 = - \frac {3}{2}.
$$

代入②式，得

$$
\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\ln [ 1 + f (x - \sin x + 1 , \sqrt {1 + x ^ {3}} + 1) ]}{\ln (1 + x ^ {3})} = \frac {1}{3} \left[ 3 \times \frac {1}{2} + \left(- \frac {3}{2}\right) \times \frac {3}{2} \right] = - \frac {1}{4}.\tag{③}
$$

将③式代入①式，得

$$
\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1}{x} \int_ {0} ^ {x} \left[ 1 + f (t - \sin t + 1, \sqrt {1 + t ^ {3}} + 1) \right] ^ {\frac {1}{\ln (1 + t ^ {3})}} d t = e ^ {- \frac {1}{4}}.
$$

方法2 利用泰勒公式计算极限 $\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(x - \sin x + 1,\sqrt{1 + x^3} + 1)}{x^3}$

由 $f$ 在点(1,2)的一阶泰勒公式，有

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {f \Big (x - \sin x + 1, \sqrt {1 + x ^ {3}} + 1 \Big) = f (1, 2) + f _ {u} (1, 2) (x - \sin x) + f _ {\nu} (1, 2) \big (\sqrt {1 + x ^ {3}} - 1 \big) + o (\rho)} \\ & {\qquad = 3 (x - \sin x) - \frac {3}{2} \big (\sqrt {1 + x ^ {3}} - 1 \big) + o (\rho),} \end{array}

\text {其中} \rho = \sqrt {(x - \sin x) ^ {2} + (\sqrt {1 + x ^ {3}} - 1) ^ {2}} \sim \sqrt {\frac {5}{1 8}} x ^ {3} \quad \left(\because x - \sin x \sim \frac {1}{6} x ^ {3}, \sqrt {1 + x ^ {3}} - 1 \sim \frac {1}{2} x ^ {3}\right).
$$

所以

$$
\begin{array}{l}\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x - \sin x + 1 , \sqrt {1 + x ^ {3}} + 1)}{x ^ {3}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {3 (x - \sin x) - \frac {3}{2} (\sqrt {1 + x ^ {3}} - 1) + o (x ^ {3})}{x ^ {3}}\\= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {3 (x - \sin x) - \frac {3}{2} (\sqrt {1 + x ^ {3}} - 1) + o (x ^ {3})}{x ^ {3}} = 3 \cdot \frac {1}{6} - \frac {3}{2} \cdot \frac {1}{2} = - \frac {1}{4}.\end{array}
$$
